owner_intent: Finish a bounded working system, not maximize agent activity. Only lane 01 and 04 selected now; reserve other shares.
interpretation: one and one means native Codex GPT for 01 and Antigravity Gemini for 04; no non-Gemini on Antigravity, no custom providers or CCR on Codex. No paid API or overflow. This is a planned assignment, not live inference authorization.

budget.unit: percentage points in each observed provider window; not tokens and not cross-provider exchangeable
budget.opening: One account-level opening snapshot per local day. For each short window, distributable daily envelope = remaining percentage points minus 15 point shared reserve. For each longer window, divide remaining minus reserve by ceil(days until observed reset), at least one. Conservative one short-window envelope per local day; fresh reset does not replenish local daily cap. Each assigned lane gets half of each envelope; inactive shares held; no borrowing or automatic reassignment.
budget.unknown_delta: Aggregate forecast and observed decreases separately; charge maximum cumulative total with one percentage-point rounding allowance per observed unchanged window identity, not per turn. If attribution/reset ambiguous, charge forecast at minimum and block further admission until reconciliation. Daily rollover preserves prior days and request history; unresolved effects block rollover.
budget.local_caps: Daily token and turn ceiling additionally mandatory, specified by owner/controller, not provider entitlement. Both provider hard windows and local share must pass. Reserve under account-wide single writer before inference; charge failed work too. Pause when either exhausted, persist checkpoint, resume only after fresh backend entitlement, new available local allocation and reconciliation.
budget.fairness: No credit shifting between providers, no paid spillover, no automatic consumption of reserved lanes. One in-flight turn per subscription account; two independent accounts can run simultaneously.

completion.controller_review: Independent evaluator retains original canonical acceptance criteria; do not copy root material or comparator data into agent workspaces. A lane defines its own finite internal completion contract from its given objective, demonstrates it, and submits a release candidate. Controller independently checks scope coverage and evidence before any external completion label.
completion.no_false_completion: Quota exhaustion, a polished README, task count, passing self-authored trivial tests, agent assertion, lack of ideas, or partial progress never constitutes completion.
completion.controller_gate_limit: Structural gate for independently controlled receipts only; does not execute or authenticate tests. External canonical tracker is separately scored; a lane's release contract does not imply all 50 program-wide gates passed.

status: SETUP_ONLY; do not launch until isolated execution, account and billing verification, atomic reservation integration, model pin and scoped-write qualification are complete
